verdict.rationale: Vendor docs explicitly state Copilot code review analyzes PRs and suggests improvements directly from the phone, matching the story precisely (docs-4, docs-10), backed by broader Copilot agent task integration in the mobile app (docs-3, docs-5, docs-6). Community evidence is generally about older app versions and other UX issues, not directly contradicting this specific Copilot review feature. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration specifically testing the Copilot PR-review feature on mobile, since community feedback predates this feature's rollout.
